classification: single-factor substitution in the C sleeve of the R344 extended-window portfolio
hypothesis: Replacing the C sleeve's generic 15% low-volatility leg with an industry-neutral 15% book-solvency-buffer leg improves the 2022 weak-market tail and net-of-5x-cost breadth without materially degrading long-window return or drawdown.
economic_rationale: The factor log((1 - debt ratio) / 20-day annualized volatility) is an interaction between balance-sheet equity cushion and market-price stability. It is not a standalone leverage or low-vol clone: candidate-only mean daily Spearman correlation with the old low-vol leg is 0.4786 and the maximum mean absolute correlation with any retained scoring leg is 0.4786.

single_mutation.control: R344 extended-window construction with C = ai_hs300_quality_momentum_broad_h60

added_component.neutralization: industry_l1 demean plus within-industry z-score; all other scoring legs are excluded from neutralization

unchanged: monthly A/B/C inverse-volatility risk parity with [0.20, 0.60] bounds
gold 200-day trend proxy and equal-weight defensive bucket

disclosure: The factor and strategy files were written before any portfolio return, drawdown, trade or concentration result was computed. The coverage-only preflight inspected factor coverage and cross-sectional correlations only. The 2022-05-05 start is inherited from R344's earliest common C-sleeve window. This is a quasi-out-of-sample temporal extension, not an independent 2018-2026 sample.

reference_control.use: fixed comparison construction; R344 remains a failed/no-candidate result and is not relabelled

data.D1_preflight: R347 preflight all checks true and no returns evaluated before preregistration
data.D2_curves: all A/B/C curves start on 2022-05-05 and extend through 2026-11-05
data.D3_input_isolation: production and R40 input trees remain byte-hash stable during execution

absolute_performance_2x.G10_no_leverage: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

concentration.C12: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

robustness.R2_gold: 159937.SZ replacement through the same proxy annual >=5%, MDD >= -20%, 2024/2025 >=0
robustness.F1_fresh: at least 5/6 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay: >=7/9 overlay lookback/target variants pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint: >=2/3 joint target variants pass core gates

satellite_cap_plateau.per_cap_core: 2x annual >=12%, Sharpe >=1.25, MDD >= -15%; 5x annual >=10%, Sharpe >=1.10, MDD >= -15%; 5x C2-C4 pass; at least 5/6 fresh starts positive
satellite_cap_plateau.P4: at least 3/4 caps pass and the 10% center passes

selection_rule: All D/G/T/X/C/R/F/P gates must pass. Otherwise record the result as research-only negative evidence and do not promote or generate paper targets. No threshold, weight, cap or window changes after results.
diagnostics: Report the 2022 partial return and drawdown versus R344 control
Report 5x top1/top3/top5 net contribution versus R344 control
Report C standalone return and drawdown as diagnostic only; portfolio gates remain authoritative
Report factor contribution and holdings overlap with the control C sleeve
discipline: One factor substitution only; no parameter scan of the solvency formula
No paper target or order file
Use historical membership, T+1 open execution and the system StrategyBacktestService
known_limitations: The book-equity/volatility ratio is not a full Merton distance-to-default model.
Financial firms are handled by within-industry neutralization rather than a separate credit model.
Current-snapshot industry classification is backfilled through history.
Membership is reconstructed and ETF qfq is not official PIT total return.
The common window starts in 2022 because TTM financial factors are unavailable earlier.
The 10% C cap, broad C design and gold trend rule were selected in prior post-hoc research.
